summary: recall, teach, learnings forget, and teach-playbook now resolve the query from stdin when no inline flag/positional is given (shared queryFromArgsOrStdin helper). Agent recipes in SKILL.md and AGENTS.md feed the question through a quoted heredoc (<<'EOF') instead of interpolating it into a shell command line. Adds internal/cli/query_stdin_test.go covering flag > positional > stdin > none precedence.
reason: Greptile policy gate: any shell-quoting scheme (double or single) still lets a crafted question break out of the quote and execute command substitution before the CLI receives it. A quoted heredoc does zero shell expansion, so apostrophes, $(...), and backticks travel to the CLI as opaque data. Interactive terminals are refused (usage error, not a hang); existing inline usage is unchanged.
validated_outcome: go build ./..., go vet ./..., and the full go test ./... suite (12 packages) pass. Live: printf 'what flies over JFK?' | opensky-pp-cli recall --agent returns the query intact; printf 'who owns aa07f9' | opensky-pp-cli teach ... exits 0 silently; learnings forget --all via stdin deletes 1 row.
upstream_issue: Template defect: the generated SKILL.md/AGENTS.md agent recipes interpolate user questions into shell commands; candidate for a cli-printing-press template fix (stdin-opaque query channel in the printed CLI + heredoc recipes).
